description: This file defines a package 'hasher' that provides functions and a class for computing hashes of Kubernetes resource nodes, including ConfigMaps and Secrets, using SHA256 and custom encoding.

classes.name: Hasher
classes.description: A class that provides a method to compute the hash of a YAML node, handling different Kubernetes resource kinds.

methods.name: SortArrayAndComputeHash
methods.description: Sorts a string array and returns a hash for it.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a hex string into a shorter string with specific character replacements, requires input length >= 10.

methods.name: hex256
methods.description: Returns the SHA256 hash of the input string in hexadecimal format.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash for a given YAML node, handling ConfigMap, Secret, or other kinds.
